source_sentences: Double-Counting Restriction Students may double-count a maximum of 2 courses for the CS minor (not including the prerequisites) toward all other majors and minors.

Students, especially from computing-related majors, interdisciplinary majors or with multiple majors or minors, are urged to consult with the Computer Science Program Director or the Undergraduate Program Coordinator in the CS Undergraduate Office to review double-counting restrictions specific to their own situations.
